summary: 银行账户/现金余额只读对账汇总首片（无迁移/无写入口）：新增 pmo_plugins/cash/bank_balance_services.py，按银行账户/期间只读派生 posted 现金 in/out 与净额、退款/退回合计、内部互转 in/out 与抵销净额、分类桥接现金账 in/out 净额、期初/期末余额（余额=期初+posted in-posted out，以 posted 现金事实派生，不建余额表），并提供 issue_code 异常清单（account_no_posted_facts、unclassified_posted_cash、ledger_net_mismatch、refund/return/transfer 跨账户或跨 org、transfer_same_account/amount_mismatch、negative_balance、future_fact_after_closed_period）。offset_implemented=false、offset_cents=0（PH-241 未合入，不读 Offset 表、不伪造）。权限 owner/finance/auditor 只读；pm/member 拒绝（银行账户与现金事实无项目归属，pm 项目摘要不可安全派生，已披露）；cash 模块停用后服务层历史可读、两条 history_read 浏览器路由 GET 仍 200。无 audit/写/迁移。浏览器新增只读账户余额汇总/异常清单页与 as_of/期间/账户筛选。

No worker self-attested pass is recorded.

deviations: PM access: the spec says pm may read only the bank summary of projects they manage, but FundingAccount/CashTransaction/Refund/BankReturn/InternalTransfer carry no project attribution, so a project-scoped pm summary cannot be derived without exposing company-wide bank data. This slice denies pm (403) together with member and discloses the spec/runtime mismatch for a future contract (same precedent as PH-279).
Offset: PH-241 is in_review and not a dependency; the snapshot never reads the Offset table, reports offset_cents=0 and offset_implemented=false, and invents no offset fact.

Balance semantics: closing_balance_cents = opening + posted_in - posted_out over posted cash facts, so actual refund/return and internal-transfer cash legs are included in the balance (they are real posted cash). ledger_net_cents is compared against the non-derived (bridgeable) posted in/out, so the expected closing-vs-ledger difference caused by derived refund/return cash is not reported as ledger_net_mismatch.

future_fact_after_closed_period uses AccountingPeriod.status='posted' plus closed_through as the closed-period signal; it reports posted cash facts dated after closed_through for the requested period.
The read path writes no generic audit (optional in the spec) and no receipt/session state, keeping the snapshot side-effect free; no verify_integrity assertion is changed or added.

Counterexamples are append-only compatible: extra LedgerPosting rows are INSERTed, never UPDATE/DELETE, so SQLite and PostgreSQL append-only triggers behave identically; assertions check derived balance/issue semantics rather than raw input values.

Single worker owns the whole write set (cash bank-balance service/funding views/template/domain metadata, delivery urls, two test files, governance); no parallel slice writes these files; independent review is pending.
